dialog.quit.title: Quit the launcher?
dialog.cancel.title: Cancel the build?
start_hint: Starts the game. You pick your fighter in the game.
native_lead: Everything OpenRecomp-FGC cannot do yet stays available there: key bindings, problem report, updates.
replays_hint: Online matches land here by themselves.
replays_lead: Online matches land here by themselves and stay on this PC.
replay_hint: Stored on this PC. The result stays hidden until you show it.
built_hint: The game is built. You only need to build again after an update.
build_hint: Builds the game from your own files. Nothing leaves this PC.
rebuild_starting: The build is starting, every step again.
rebuild_hint: Redoes every step. Hold to confirm.
rebuild_lead: Redoes every step, also finished ones. Saves are kept. Hold the button until the bar is full.
manifest_screens: OpenRecomp-FGC builds all screens from it.
manifest_hint: A new recomp is just one entry: name, colour, sections, build or exe.
dialog_hint: No is preselected. A stray press changes nothing.
drawer_hint: Friends, lobby, key bindings and problem reports are still in the games' own launchers.
fighter_hint: Used if you do not pick in the game in time.
osk_hint: The D-pad picks the key. A real keyboard works too.
picker_files_hint: Shows only folders and matching files.
hold_hint: Hold with the pad or Enter.
no_native: This game has no launcher of its own.
no_build_here: This game is not built through OpenRecomp-FGC.
folder_hint: Show OpenRecomp-FGC where the game is.
generic_hint: Starts the file the manifest names.
t5.ready_detail: Your game runs locally on this PC. You pick your fighter in the game.
t5.rebuild_detail: This version changes the game code: build once, about 2 minutes.
t5.build_detail: Choose your package and license in the Build section.
display.hint: How the game window opens. F11 and Alt+Enter work in the game too.
display.lead: Borderless fills the screen, a window keeps the PC usable.
resolution.hint: How sharply the game is rendered.
resolution.t5_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Online, each player may use another step.
vsync.hint: Off: least lag, the picture may tear.
vsync.lead: Only changes how the picture reaches the screen.
effects.hint: Hit sparks, flames, smoke, mist, waterfalls.
stage_blur.hint: Soft focus and glow of some stages.
input_delay.hint: Auto picks by ping. Both players set it.
input_delay.lead: More delay means less rollback. In ranked the server sets it.
training.hint: Inputs and frame data in Practice. F2 switches in the game.
training.lead: Shows startup and advantage of every move.
practice.hint: SELECT combos, dummy and recordings in Practice.
always_left.hint: As P2 this PC shows the fight mirrored, you stand on the left.
always_left.lead: Only the picture on this PC changes.
save_replays.hint: Online matches are saved as replays on this PC.
save_replays.lead: A match takes only a few KB.
old_stages.hint: Tekken 5 stages without clearing Arcade. Your save stays as it is.
free_items.hint: All shop items free. Your save is backed up first.
package.hint: Your game package from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
license.hint: Your license file from your own account. Nothing leaves this PC.
responsive.hint: The build is slower, the PC stays usable.
responsive.lead: The build is slower, but the PC stays usable meanwhile.
t4.ready_detail: Tekken 4 (USA) runs natively on this PC.
resolution.t4_lead: Higher steps need more graphics power. Auto takes the step of your screen.
fullscreen.hint: F11 or Alt+Enter in the game work too.
sound.hint: The real game sound on the emulated IOP.
sound.lead: Without sound the game runs with a silent stand-in.
unlock_all.lead: All fighters from the start, without changing your save.
debug.hint: F1 in the game opens the debug window.
iso.hint: Tekken 4 USA as an ISO (SLUS-20328). No BIOS needed.
fighter.lead: After a match is found you pick in the game (30 s, Select = random). The fighter here is used if you do not pick in time.
search.hint: The search runs in the T5DR launcher, OpenRecomp-FGC opens it for you.
ranked.lead: Counts for your rank. The search runs in the T5DR launcher, where you also see the match and ready check.
casual.lead: Unrated, by ping. The search runs in the T5DR launcher.
lobby.hint: The T5DR launcher with lobby, rooms, tournaments, friends and leaderboard.
lobby.lead: Rooms, tournaments, friends, spectating and leaderboard stay in the T5DR launcher.
player_name.hint: Your name for the lobby. The on-screen keyboard is enough.
player_name.lead: How you appear in the lobby.
native_hint: The {name}: controls, problem report and everything not here yet.
game_not_found: OpenRecomp-FGC did not find {name} on this PC.
search_starting: T5DR launcher is starting the search: {name}.
search_opening: T5DR launcher is opening. Start {name} there.
